A specialized sampling routine for NeRF-based methods (NGLOD) that ensures training positions are generated within octree leaf nodes to avoid invalid queries, replacing the uniform unit cube sampling [S1].

The claim states that a specialized sampling routine for NGLOD replaces uniform unit cube sampling with generation of positions within octree leaf nodes to avoid invalid queries. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states: 'we replace the uniform unit cube sampling routine with one that creates uniform 3D positions in the leaf nodes of the octree... To this end, we replace the uniform unit cube sampling routine with one that creates uniform 3D positions in the leaf nodes of the octree by first rejection sampling a uniformly random leaf node from the array of all nodes and then generating a uniform random position within the node's voxel.' This matches the claim exactly.
